action: Chase customers: check that transfers, bill payments and Zelle payments from November 16 went through once and only once, and contact the bank about anything missing or duplicated. No security action is needed.
exec: A software fault at a major US bank disrupted payments for hours; Chase and the FBI found no sign of a cyber cause.
impact: Thousands of customers reported trouble accessing online accounts on November 16 (6abc); no exact count is given by the sources read.
plain: Chase customers had trouble with online banking and payments for several hours on November 16, which also affected some transactions at other banks. JPMorgan says a software release caused it and that it was not a cyberattack.
summary: Chase customers had trouble with online banking, transactions and Zelle payments for hours on November 16. Chase said a software bug in on-premise hardware systems caused it, with no evidence it was cyber-related; the FBI told NewsNation it saw no signs of malicious or external activity and linked it to a software release. Chase said partner banks in shared transactions may also have been affected.
title: JPMorgan Chase outage ripples to other major US banks

validation.note: Compared 6abc live blog and Yahoo News (FBI via NewsNation): both give Chase software bug, not cyber-related; FBI no malicious activity.
